channel.description: A private daily briefing for Andrew Rux on AI tooling and automation for valuation firms, with special focus on litigation support and healthcare-related valuations.

item.title: Valuation AI Briefing - Wed 11 Nov 2026
item.description:
Daily briefing on AI tooling and automation for valuation firms, focused on litigation support and healthcare valuations, and how the day's stories could be useful to a firm like Strategic Value Group.

Sources discussed:

  • Quarterly AI Update for Valuators: Getting Started with Agents (NACVA/ValuSource)
  • AI and FMV: Balancing Innovation with Professional Judgment (ECG Management Consultants)
  • Marshall & Stevens Acquires Baumann Moreau, Expanding Florida Footprint and Strengthening Litigation Support Practice (PR Newswire)
  • AI and the Valuer: Which Judgments Should Never Be Delegated (Business Valuation Resources)
  • What we learned at the AICPA’s FVS Conference (Business Valuation Resources)
